entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's a complete piece of junk and I'm not paying for it.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, it's just horribly designed! It's so hard to use, and navigating the menus is incredibly confusing. I expected more from a brand-new device. I even read the user manual and it was no help at all. This is not what I paid for.

I can certainly understand the frustration when a new device doesn't feel intuitive. I can help with that. Often, the workout tracking can feel a bit complex at first. Were you trying to set up custom heart rate zones, or perhaps track a specific activity?

Look, I don't want a tutorial! I'm telling you the product is bad. I've had it for over two weeks and I still can't get it to do what I want. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager right now?
My apologies, I was just trying to help. Of course, I can look into the return for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your order number or the email address used for the purchase?
It's under angrycustomer@email.com. And you'd better not give me any trouble with this, because I'm one click away from posting a very detailed, very negative review about this whole experience.

I understand completely. Thank you for the email. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. And it looks like it was delivered 18 days ago. Let me just check our policy here... one moment please.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Wait, really? So you'll just take it back? No fees or nonsense?

That's correct. You're eligible for a full refund. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I've just sent it to the email on file. Simply pack the band back in its original packaging, apply that label, and you can drop it off at any post office. As soon as our warehouse logs its arrival, your refund will be processed.
Oh. Okay then. Well, that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just send the label.
It's on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
